scriptReview.source:
checked = 0
for glyph in font.glyphs:
    i = int(glyph.name[5:])
    layer = glyph.layers[params['master']]
    assert layer.width == (500.375 if i < 4096 else 500), glyph.name
    assert not layer.temporarilyDisableRounding(), glyph.name
    assert not layer.background.temporarilyDisableRounding(), glyph.name
    manager = glyph.undoManager()
    assert manager.groupingLevel() == 0, glyph.name
    assert manager.groupsByEvent(), glyph.name
    checked += 1
print('Verified', checked, 'glyphs: widths, rounding flags, closed Undo groups')
